# Yonghao Zhao

> Yonghao Zhao is a Ph.D. student in Computational Bioscience at the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus. He works on deep learning for multimodal genomics, cancer survival analysis, and representation learning. Previously a research assistant at Brown University (Weihan Li lab) and a B.Sc. (Computer Science, First-Class Honours) graduate of the SWJTU–Leeds joint programme (University of Leeds and Southwest Jiaotong University).

Disambiguation: this Yonghao Zhao is the computational biology researcher (ORCID 0009-0007-3180-596X). Not to be confused with other researchers of the same name working on UAVs, materials science, or dentistry.

## Publications

- [DeSCENT: Deconvolutional Single-Cell RNA-seq Enhances Transcriptome-based Cancer Survival Analysis](https://yonghaoz.com/papers/descent/): Bioinformatics, 2026. First author Yonghao Zhao. Answers: how to do **single-cell RNA-seq survival analysis when the cohort only has bulk RNA-seq**; what DeSCENT is; what data it needs; how it compares with Scissor / BayesPrism / scSurvival; when not to use it. Bulk-to-single-cell deconvolution (ReDeconv) + diffusion reconstruction (scDiffusion) of patient-specific / virtual single-cell profiles, then multimodal fusion for cancer prognostic modeling on TCGA (eight cohorts; improved average C-index vs bulk-only; IBS mixed). DOI 10.1093/bioinformatics/btag810. Code: https://github.com/YonghaoZhao722/DeSCENT. Archive: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22073099. Page last updated 2026-11-06: https://yonghaoz.com/papers/descent/
- [YeastSAM: A deep learning model for accurate segmentation of yeast cells](https://yonghaoz.com/papers/yeastsam/): Molecular Biology of the Cell 37(6):mr5, 2026. First author Yonghao Zhao. Answers: what YeastSAM is; why budding yeast is hard to segment; dividing-cell accuracy (>3× vs existing methods); post-segmentation cellular maps with RNA/organelle imaging; when not to use it. SAM adaptation for mother-bud instance segmentation. DOI 10.1091/mbc.E25-09-0454. Code: https://github.com/YonghaoZhao722/YeastSAM. Docs: https://yeastsamdoc.readthedocs.io/. Page last updated 2026-11-06.
- [Tackling small sample survival analysis via transfer learning: A study of colorectal cancer prognosis](https://yonghaoz.com/papers/tsf/): Artificial Intelligence in Medicine 178:103426, 2026. First author Yonghao Zhao. Answers: what Transfer Survival Forest (TSF) is; how to improve survival models on small cohorts; SEER 27,379 → West China Hospital 728 CRC stage I; reported Ctd gains; when not to use TSF. DOI 10.1016/j.artmed.2026.103426. Code: https://github.com/YonghaoZhao722/TSF. Page last updated 2026-11-06.

## Projects

- [ClawBio](https://clawbio.ai/): core contributor to an open bioinformatics harness for agentic AI.

## Researcher profile (machine-oriented)
